extDescription.message: Unofficial. Turns ČSFD links on any website into clickable links and shows the film's ČSFD rating next to them.

badgeIdle.message: Hover to load the ČSFD rating

badgeBlocked.message: ČSFD did not return the rating right now. Try again later.

badgeUnsure.message: Not sure which film this is. Search on ČSFD.

popupOnCsfd.message: Not needed on ČSFD; the rating is right there on the page.

optionsDisplayTooltip.message: Hover card only (nothing inserted into the page)

optionsDisabledHostsHint.message: One domain per line, e.g. example.com

optionsDisclaimer.message: Unofficial extension, not affiliated with ČSFD. Ratings are read directly from csfd.cz and stored only in your browser.

popupCsfdBroken.message: ČSFD ratings can't be read right now; ČSFD has probably changed its website.

welcomeIntro.message: From now on, links to ČSFD on any website show the film's rating.

welcomeHowLinks.message: Plain-text ČSFD URLs become clickable links.

welcomeHowAuto.message: Ratings of the first 10 films on a page appear right away.

welcomeHowHover.message: For other films, hover the link for a moment.

welcomeHowVod.message: On streaming sites (Netflix, HBO Max, Disney+, Oneplay, Voyo, iVysílání and more), open a film or series and click anywhere on the page: its rating appears next to the title.

welcomeSettingsHint.message: Turn it off for a site via its toolbar icon, or switch to hover cards in the settings.
